an2.1:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an2.1:2.3: Diṭṭhadhammikañ ca vajjaṃ samparāyikañ ca vajjaṃ.
an2.1:2.5: Idha bhikkhave ekacco passati coraṃ āgucāriṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakaraṇā kārente
an2.1:2.6: kasāhi pi tāḷente, vettehi pi tāḷente, addhadaṇḍakehi pi tāḷente, hattham pi chindante, pādam pi chindante, hatthapādam pi chindante, kaṇṇam pi chindante, nāsam pi chindante, kaṇṇanāsam pi chindante, bilaṅgathālikam pi karonte, saṅkhamuṇḍikam pi karonte, rāhumukham pi karonte, jotimālikam pi karonte, hatthapajjotikam pi karonte, erakavattikam pi karonte, cīrakavāsikam pi karonte, eṇeyyakam pi karonte, balisamaṃsikam pi karonte, kahāpaṇakam pi karonte, khārāpatacchikam pi karonte, palighaparivattikam pi karonte, palālapīṭhakam pi karonte, tattena pi telena osiñcante, sunakhehi pi khādāpente, jīvantam pi sūle uttāsente, asinā pi sīsaṃ chindante.
an2.1:3.2: yathārūpānaṃ kho pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ hetu coraṃ āgucāriṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakaraṇā kārenti
an2.1:3.3: kasāhi pi tāḷenti . . . pe . . . asinā pi sīsaṃ chindanti.
an2.1:3.4: Ahañ ce va kho pana evarūpaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ kareyyaṃ mam pi rājāno gahetvā evarūpā vividhā kammakaraṇā kāreyyuṃ
an2.1:3.5: kasāhi pi tāḷeyyuṃ . . . pe . . . asinā pi sīsaṃ chindeyyun ti.
an2.1:3.6: So diṭṭhadhammikassa vajjassa bhīto na paresaṃ pābhataṃ palumpanto carati.
an2.1:4.3: kāyaduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ vacīduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ manoduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ
an2.1:4.4: ahañ ce va kho pana kāyena duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ vācāya duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ manasā duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ
an2.1:4.5: kiñ ca taṃ yenāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjeyyan ti.
an2.1:4.6: So samparāyikassa vajjassa bhīto kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti suddham attānaṃ pariharati.
an2.1:4.10: diṭṭhadhammikassa vajjassa bhāyissāma samparāyikassa vajjassa bhāyissāma vajjabhīruno bhavissāma
an2.1:4.12: vajjabhayadassāvino ti. Evaṃ hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabbaṃ. Vajjabhīruno bhikkhave vajja-bhayadassāvino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ parimuñcissati sabbavajjehī ti. 2. Dve
an2.2:1.3: Yañ ca gihīnaṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasaraṃ cīvara-piṇḍapātasenāsana-gilāna-paccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārānuppādānatthaṃ padhānaṃ yañ ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ sabbūpadhi-paṭinissaggatthāya padhānaṃ.
an2.2:1.4: Imāni kho bhikkhave dve padhānāni durabhisaṃbhavāni lokasmiṃ.
an2.2:2.1: Etad aggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ padhānānaṃ yadidaṃ sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggatthaṃ padhānaṃ.
an2.3:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa kāyaduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti akataṃ hoti kāyasucaritaṃ:
an2.3:1.4: vacīduccaritam kataṃ hoti akataṃ hoti vacīsucaritaṃ:
an2.3:1.5: manoduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti akataṃ hoti manosucaritaṃ.
an2.3:1.6: So kāyaduccaritaṃ me katan ti tappati akataṃ me kāyasucaritan ti tappati:
an2.3:1.7: vacīduccaritaṃ me katan ti tappati akataṃ me vacīsucaritan ti tappati:
an2.3:1.8: manoduccaritam me katan ti tappati akataṃ me manosucaritan ti tappati.
an2.3:1.9: Ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā tapanīyā ti. 4.
an2.4:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa kāyasucaritaṃ kataṃ hoti akataṃ hoti kāyaduccaritaṃ: . . .
an2.4:1.6: So kāyasucaritaṃ me katan ti na tappati akataṃ me kāyaduccaritan ti na tappati . . .
an2.4:1.9: Ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā atapanīyā
an2.5:1.2: yā ca asantuṭṭhitā kusalesu dhammesu yā ca appaṭivāṇitā padhānasmiṃ.
an2.5:1.4: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ yan tam purisa-thāmena purisa-viriyena purisa-parakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī ti.
an2.5:1.5: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave appamādādhigatā bodhi appamādādhigato anuttaro yogakkhemo.
an2.5:1.6: Tumhe ce pi bhikkhave appaṭivāṇaṃ padaheyyātha --
an2.5:1.7: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ yan taṃ purisa-thāmena purisaviriyena purisa-parakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī ti -- tumhe pi bhikkhave na cirass' eva
an2.5:1.8: yass' atthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatha.
an2.5:1.11: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ yan taṃ purisa-thāmena purisaviriyena purisa-parakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatī ti. Evaṃ
an2.6:1.3: Yā ca saññojaniyesu dhammesu assādānupassitā yā ca saññojaniyesu dhammesu nibbidānupassitā.
an2.6:1.4: Saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassī viharanto rāgaṃ nappajahati dosaṃ nappajahati mohaṃ nappajahati.
an2.6:1.5: Rāgaṃ appahāya dosaṃ appahāya mohaṃ appahāya na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
an2.6:2.1: Saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu nibbidānupassī viharanto rāgam pajahati dosam pajahati moham pajahati.
an2.6:2.2: Rāgam pahāya dosam pahāya moham pahāya parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
an2.6:2.4: Ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā ti. 7.
an2.7:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā kaṇhā ti. 8.
an2.8:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā sukkā ti. 9.
an2.9:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ na pāleyyuṃ nayidha paññāyetha mātā ti vā mātucchā ti vā mātulānī ti vā ācariya-bhariyā ti vā garūnaṃ dārā ti vā,
an2.9:1.5: saṃbhedaṃ loko āgamissati yathā ajelakā kukkuṭa-sūkarā soṇa-sigālā.
an2.9:1.6: Yasmā ca kho bhikkhave ime dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ pālenti tasmā paññāyati mātā ti vā mātucchā ti vā mātulānī ti vā ācariya-bhariyā ti vā garūnaṃ dārā ti vā ti. 10.
an2.10:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave dve vassūpanāyikā ti.
